title: Carrie & Lowell
creator: Sufjan Stevens
summary: Stevens processing the death of his estranged mother through the quietest, most devastating folk you'll hear.
personalNote: I put this on during a long drive and had to pull over. Not because it's a sad album — though it is — but because it's so specific. The grief is particular and named and that makes it more universal somehow. Death With Dignity and Should Have Known Better are in my permanent memory. Return it to regularly, always unexpectedly.
whyIReturn: It's the most honest thing I've heard about grief.
